verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a remote-desktop and remote-access tool. It has no AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or MCP-client feature that would make the axis apply; its CLI and REST API are admin automation surfaces, not tool-consuming agent features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
